info.name: task_manager
info.description: **Task Management REST API** is a simple RESTful API built with **Go** and the **Gin Framework**. It provides basic CRUD (Create, Read, Update, Delete) operations for managing tasks using an in-memory data store. This collection contains all available endpoints for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting tasks, along with example requests and responses for testing the APIEndFragment

request.description:
Creates a new task in the system.  
The request requires task details including title, description, due date, and status.
Retrieves the details of a specific task using its unique ID. Returns the task information if the task exists; otherwise, returns a not found error.EndFragment
Retrieves a list of all tasks currently stored in the system. Returns an array containing all available tasks.EndFragment

Updates the details of an existing task using its ID. The request body should contain the updated task information. Returns the updated task after a successful update.

EndFragment
Deletes a specific task from the system using its unique ID. Returns a success message if the task is deleted; otherwise, returns a not found error.EndFragment
